reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original p0066 — no edit and no counterparty comment were proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The playbook's preferred position for NOSOLICIT is the absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer; the cited paragraph is a standard independent-contractor/no-agency clause that imposes no restrictive covenant, so the absence of a non-solicit anywhere in the Agreement matches the preferred position.
The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure; they do not indicate a defect here.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately scoped — it records the compliance basis as internal evidence without raising a negotiation issue.
